notes.text: Available in cPanel 108 and later; operates on the selected cPanel account. Omitted optional arguments, including null, remain omitted; explicit empty strings, false and zero are sent according to their parameter types. No client-side defaults are substituted.

Returns a list of role objects with optional features string list, id string and title string. Reviewed Cpanel/Team/RoleDescription.pm on cPanel 11.138.0.19 returns an array reference; the pinned FeatureDescriptions object describes one element. Team was unavailable on that server, so this correction is supported by source inspection and offline replay only.

evidence.note: Reviewer source inspection https://github.com/hostingpal/whm-api-client/pull/43#pullrequestreview-5720337990 against b40a9e3158c7e6dd2ff139c5e76a03536fa9ce87: Cpanel/Team/RoleDescription.pm returns the features_list_description_mapping array reference. Cpanel/API/TeamRoles.pm POD shows one role element, while pinned FeatureDescriptions models that element as the whole payload. Correct the root to a list, retaining each role's optional features string list, id string and title string. Team is unavailable on that server; this is upstream-source evidence with offline replay, not a live Team result.
